description: The CO2 estimate of a solution (results, train detail, journey detail): emission factors per passenger-kilometre in grams of CO2 equivalent, well-to-wheel, from the European Environment Agency report «Transport and environment report 2020 – Train or plane?» (EEA Report No 19/2020): an international high-speed electric train, an average fossil-fuelled car with 1.5 occupants and an A320 on 500 and 1,000 km. The distance factors are Binario's own assumptions, stated in the credits: rail and road are longer than the great circle between stations, a flight adds 8 % for routing and holding. No estimate under minimumKm.
source: EEA Report No 19/2020, Transport and environment report 2020 – Train or plane?
